issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.author is a String (a Book consists of two Strings: title and author), but the solution implementation declares Book.author as Bool. This attribute type mismatch contradicts the specification and will confuse students (and the Client usage which prints author as a String).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book.author property in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift from Bool to String to match the problem specification. Update the property declaration to `let author: String` and adjust any comments if necessary so Client printing and all usages consistently treat author as a String.
